newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 12.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -June 12.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and People News.
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

PARIS - French newspapers earned strong advertising income in the first quarter of 1997, with Liberation, Le Monde and La Tribune outperforming the average daily. At Liberation, advertising income for the four months to end-April was nine percent up on the same 1996 period, says Liberation managing director Evence-Charles Coppee.(Reuter)

PARIS - The appointment of Eric Licoys as managing director of Havas will help Havas to carry out its aggressive strategy, Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier tells financial daily newspaper La Tribune Desfosses. (Reuter)

PARIS - Food group Danone is using the World Cup football tournament, which takes place in France next year, as the launching pad for various promotions, including sponsoring children's football matches in several countries and an international advertising spot with Saatchi & Saatchi. (Le Figaro).
MEDIA & THE INTERNET
PARIS - French public television channel France 2 declines to comment on a report in Le Monde newspaper that it will show a loss of at least 70 million francs ($12 million) for 1996.
(Reuter)

PARIS - Talks over U.S. media company Time Warner buying the loss-making cable television unit of France's Generale des Eaux are continuing but have not yet been concluded, Jean-Marie Messier, chairman of Generale des Eaux, tells the company's annual meeting. (Reuter)

PARIS - Internet service provider Infonie is offering subscribers a voice service on the Internet from the end of this month, which would allow them to talk on-line anywhere in the world for the price of a local call. (La Tribune)

PARIS - A Paris court rejects bourse regulator CMF's decision to waive a requirement for Lagardere Group to bid for all of Filipacchi Medias as part of its plan to combine its media activities with those of Filipacchi, Lagardere says. (Reuter)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS

PARIS - A Paris court fines top executives of tobacco companies Seita and Rothmans after finding that health warnings printed on their cigarette packages distorted the meaning of the labelling law. (Reuter)

NANTES - Freak hailstorms damage some vineyards producing Muscadet wine in western France. The local chamber of agriculture says some wine producers complained hailstones damaged up to 60 percent of their vines. The region is known for white Muscadet wine. (Reuter)
PEOPLE NEWS:

PARIS - The following people have been appointed as advisers in the private office of Culture and Communication minister Catherine Trautmann: Dominique Lefebvre, Norbert Engel, Pierre Encreve, Frederic Scanvic, Marc Nicolas, Franck Hebert, Marylene Courivaud. (Reuter)
PARIS - Alexandre Michelin, managing director of cable television channel Paris Premiere, is to be director of digital programmes at Canal Plus. (Le Figaro).
Paris Editorial, Sue Landau
For further information and news, see Reuters Advertising & Media Briefing. And visit us on the Internet at http://www.Bizinfo.reuters.com
